title: Vesperglass Workshop Tools
description: Six interpretive still lifes inspired by the unnamed wall-tool group in the proposed Vesperglass Workshop cutaway. Their names and serials identify this website set, not a source inventory.

items.name: Drafting dividers
items.alt: An interpretive still life of brass drawing dividers on a pale worktable before brass-framed star-facing windows, evoking the Vesperglass Workshop.

items.name: Marking gauge
items.alt: An interpretive still life of a hardwood marking gauge with brass fittings on a pale worktable before the Vesperglass Workshop's star-facing windows.

items.name: Smoothing plane
items.alt: An interpretive still life of a wooden smoothing plane with iron and brass details on a pale worktable before the Vesperglass Workshop's star-facing windows.

items.name: Joiner's mallet
items.alt: An interpretive still life of a bronze-headed, walnut-handled mallet on a pale worktable before brass-framed star-facing windows, evoking the Vesperglass Workshop.

items.name: Plumb bob
items.alt: An interpretive still life of a polished brass plumb bob on a pale worktable before the Vesperglass Workshop's tall star-facing windows.

items.name: Hand drill
items.alt: An interpretive still life of a hand drill with hardwood crank and aged brass fittings on a pale worktable before the Vesperglass Workshop's star-facing windows.

title: Gate Bloom Studies
description: Six interpretive sci-fi studies inspired by the Vesperglass Gate account's described bloom. Their sequence and visual details are artistic interpretations, not additional world facts.

items.name: First Light
items.alt: Interpretive sci-fi artwork of delicate turquoise and pale-gold filaments first appearing in the dark glass aperture of the Vesperglass Gate.

items.name: Radial Unfurl
items.alt: Interpretive sci-fi artwork of fine luminous strands opening radially from the Vesperglass Gate center.

items.name: Prismatic Lattice
items.alt: Interpretive sci-fi artwork of an intricate teal and gold lattice of light crossing the Vesperglass Gate aperture.

items.name: Full Radiance
items.alt: Interpretive sci-fi artwork of the Vesperglass Gate at full bloom, surrounded by precise luminous radial strands.

items.name: Layered Refraction
items.alt: Interpretive sci-fi artwork of translucent veils of teal and pale-gold light refracting through the Vesperglass Gate.

items.name: Afterglow
items.alt: Interpretive sci-fi artwork of the Vesperglass Gate as luminous filaments fade into a quiet halo and sparse stars.
